author: MagicWafflezYT
body:
Listen, I've been send email after email trying to get back on Avicus. For the last time I wasn't hacking, it was some kind of glitch. This is my favorite server, and it has been since day one. So please let me back on, it won't happen again.

Pease Read This

       -MagicWafflez

title: Why was I banned???

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,
Do you remember the situation that you were in before you were banned? It's very unlikely that you were banned for flying due to a glitch. In the meantime, I'll alert {tag=d59ceecc21d24899a74b4c15c9c1dd12} to respond to your appeal as he's the moderator who punished you.
